comment: flexasr's own built-in providers (not models). Models come from the shared registry (registries/asr in the flexitools models repository); registry-snapshot.json is a copy for offline first use.

models.note: One speaker for the whole recording. Needs nothing; the last resort when no diarizer is usable.

Built-in diarization shipped with flexasr (MFCC + clustering, numpy only): no download. Experimental: on real recordings (crpcoral, 8 files, 2026-10-11) it scored below treating everything as one speaker, so it is never chosen automatically; use --provider diarize=builtin-diar explicitly. The fallback is wespeaker-resnet34-lm.
Keeps the word times the transcriber produced (no separate alignment).
